bind._src: runtime-pressure R29: the wrap layout was the one layout with no repeater. A bound flow repeats its single child template per row; an unbound one lays out its authored children.

key._src: the shared keying law (`index` keys positionally; a row missing the field falls back to its position) - the same fold list/grid/pager use.

notes: Greedy flow-wrap: pack left-to-right at ideal sizes, break on overflow (FlowLayout, Flow.swift:43-90). REPEATER (2026-08-26): `<flow bind= key=>` drives the wrap from data. The packer never learns a repeater exists, because the rows ARE the subviews - which is why bind cost no layout change on any renderer.
